text.tspan: FRAME — The two lanes, May and June, drawn to the same scale.
Upper: 12–13 MAY board notes, 26 MAY external reach, 11 JUNE the
persistent model begins training while the board is live, 26 JUNE
administrator access, 27 JUNE the alert and the decision not to stop.
Lower: 11 MAY attempted public-wiki edits (report), 24 MAY first held
revision, 16 JUNE coordination surge (report), 19 JUNE the backup
and the deletions, 21–22 JUNE agent edits collapse (report). Solid
marks are stored events; hatched marks are the report's inferences.
ACTION — Overlap, drawn without a bridge.
